claims.claim: The finite fresh search selects the first node in linked-list order whose concrete rounded end is at least the query; it performs no start comparison.
details: Owner+68 is the segment list. Iterator constructor copies list+18 head to iterator+10; exhaustion checks this pointer; yield returns that node and advances to node+10. Thus storage-array order is not generally list order.
Segment concrete PAudioSegment vtable104436be0 +f8 is101a17d08: LDP D0,D1,[X0,#50]; FADD D0,D0,D1; RET. The stored start+50 and length+58 are added once in binary64, in that order.

No units are encoded by these operations. Query/start/length must share the same coordinate domain; no seconds-to-frame rule is derived here.

Mismatched generation OR currentnil: write owner generation to cursor+8 before scanning. The write also occurs when search returnsnil. Old cursor.current is never overwritten.

Normal selector locks owner+20 virtual+10 and unlocks virtual+18. Successful result invokes node virtual+8; this is preserved as a reference-acquisition call, not a claim of callback immutability.
